Zacharia is a senior communications adviser to Trump Media & Technology Group, which operates Truth Social, and appears on Fox News. She has also worked in Republican politics, government communications and conservative advocacy. Zacharia spent about three months at the Department of Homeland Security in early 2026, leaving after Markwayne Mullin became secretary. She later worked with Fix California, a conservative group founded by Trump special envoy Ric Grenell that promotes conservative policies.
